snippet.title: How to reverse engineer Expensify with Claude: what passed, what broke
snippet.description:
Claude built an Expensify alternative from one Markdown spec: all 24 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 59 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 9 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for small-team expense reports and had it build the tool in four phases: sign-in, people and settings; reports, expenses, receipts and policy flags; approval and payment; and reminders and spending. The gaps included a seed that loads relative to today while the checks used fixed dates, two rules that named different people who can see a receipt, and changing a report's approver with no event, email or comment rule. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when Expensify is still worth paying for.
